sources.title: Configuring for Reproducible Builds
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: OpenTelemetry：停機積壓與恢復排空證據
related.titleEn: OpenTelemetry: outage backlog and recovery drain evidence
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：66.667%與83.333%可重算，兩個路徑差異仍明列；兩次同機成功不被誤稱完成獨立重建驗證。 交付maven-buildcompare.csv、12對摘要及時間/路徑差異報告；僅建置本地無敏感範例，不發布套件。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Reproduce approximately 66.667 and 83.333 percent and list the two remaining path differences. Two same-machine successes alone must not be described as completed independent reproducibility verification. Deliver maven-buildcompare.csv, all 12 digest pairs and timestamp/path difference reports using local nonsensitive examples without publishing packages.
related.difference: 繪製接收、入列、送出與丟棄四個計數邊界，以事件ID建立守恆帳本，另記重試到期及磁碟容量。
related.differenceEn: Map received, enqueued, exported and dropped counters, reconcile event IDs, and separately record retry expiration and disk capacity.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課以位元組完全一致的產物比例衡量重建覆蓋；固定時間只是其中一項條件，需檢查工具版本與環境外洩。不同Maven版本預設行為應依文件核對，不假設都需同一手動開關。 12對產物中8對位元組相同，2對只差封存時間，2對含工作路徑差異；四個差異案例互不重疊。 相同比例8/12×100≈66.667%；修復兩個時間差異產物後變10/12×100≈83.333%，工作路徑差異仍存在。

恢復後淨排空率為輸出速率減新輸入；若差值不正，增加緩衝只能延後滿載。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 合成輸入每秒240筆，停機180秒，空佇列容量60000筆；恢復輸出每秒360筆，不計批次額外開銷。 積壓240×180=43200筆；排空時間43200/(360−240)=360秒；這是記錄數模型，不是Exporter批次設定值。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Measure byte-identical artifacts as rebuild coverage. Fixed time is one condition among tool versions and environment leakage. Check documented defaults for the selected Maven release rather than assuming every version requires the same manual switch. Eight of 12 artifact pairs are byte-identical, two differ only in archive timestamps and two embed different working paths. Keep the four differing cases disjoint and retain the exact byte-range or structured archive differences. Equality is 8/12×100, approximately 66.667 percent. Repairing the two timestamp-only artifacts gives 10/12×100, approximately 83.333 percent, while the working-path differences remain unresolved.

Net recovery drain rate is output minus continuing input; nonpositive surplus means buffering only delays saturation. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Synthetic input is 240 records/s during a 180-second outage, with capacity 60000 records and recovered output 360 records/s. Backlog is 43200 records; draining takes 43200/(360−240)=360 seconds. These record counts are not exporter batch settings.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: AWS CloudTrail：Digest鏈範圍與缺口聲明
related.titleEn: AWS CloudTrail: digest-chain scope and explicit gaps

Two same-machine successes alone must not be described as completed independent reproducibility verification. Deliver maven-buildcompare.csv, all 12 digest pairs and timestamp/path difference reports using local nonsensitive examples without publishing packages.
related.difference: 建立小時、digest、前一摘要鏈接及log檔對照，區分未驗證、驗證失敗與根本未收錄。
related.differenceEn: Map hours, digests, predecessor links and log files, distinguishing unvalidated, failed and never-covered intervals.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 本課以位元組完全一致的產物比例衡量重建覆蓋；固定時間只是其中一項條件，需檢查工具版本與環境外洩。不同Maven版本預設行為應依文件核對，不假設都需同一手動開關。 12對產物中8對位元組相同，2對只差封存時間，2對含工作路徑差異；四個差異案例互不重疊。 相同比例8/12×100≈66.667%；修復兩個時間差異產物後變10/12×100≈83.333%，工作路徑差異仍存在。
本課計算的是時間窗口覆蓋，不是密碼安全機率；自編雜湊鏈不能冒充AWS簽章驗證。 本課所有數值、事件與系統狀態均為原創合成資料；只在本機檔案與授權隔離練習中處理，不接觸生產設備或他人資料。 24個預期小時，各有一個教學摘要槽位；其中2小時未啟用收錄，另1個摘要缺失，其餘21個可核對。 可核對時間覆蓋21/24=87.5%；未啟用與遺失共3小時應各自列出。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Measure byte-identical artifacts as rebuild coverage. Fixed time is one condition among tool versions and environment leakage. Check documented defaults for the selected Maven release rather than assuming every version requires the same manual switch. Eight of 12 artifact pairs are byte-identical, two differ only in archive timestamps and two embed different working paths. Keep the four differing cases disjoint and retain the exact byte-range or structured archive differences. Equality is 8/12×100, approximately 66.667 percent. Repairing the two timestamp-only artifacts gives 10/12×100, approximately 83.333 percent, while the working-path differences remain unresolved.

Measure time-window coverage rather than cryptographic security probability; a teaching hash chain is not AWS signature validation. Every quantity, event and system state below is original synthetic teaching data. Work only on local files or an explicitly authorized isolated lab, without production access or other people’s data. Twenty-four expected hourly slots include two disabled intervals and one missing digest; twenty-one remain locally checkable. Checkable temporal coverage is 21/24=87.5%; list the three uncovered hours by distinct cause.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
